attempts.text:
**The window starts in a persistent efflux stretch.** Columns 0 to 15, `mdtN` to `actP` through the `nrf` genes, are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 12% of calls. The model names 90 to 99% of them, fewest at `yjcO`, and hesitates most at `mdtO`, 0.59 bits.

**A variable column follows at `espX5`**, column 16, in a region of plasticity in 0.4% of calls, named 82%, 0.80 bits. Then columns 17 to 20, `yjcE` to `soxS`, are spine at 97%, named 96 to 99%. Column 21, `pdeC`, is variable, named 85%.

**Columns 22 to 27 run `yjcB` to `aphA`**, spine at 91 to 97%, named 85 to 97%, most hesitant at `aphA`, 0.86 bits. Column 28, `yjbS`, is the window's most hesitant, 1.08 bits, named 85%. Columns 29 to 34, `tyrB` to `dusA`, are spine at 96 to 97%, named 82 to 97%.

**The long fork and variable stretch runs columns 35 to 79**, in a region of plasticity in 12 to 36% of calls, named 83 to 95%. A second branch of 7 families, `sorC` to `sorE`, [[sorbose sugar transport]], runs through columns 61 to 67, carried by 26 to 30% of chromosomes. The window ends at `yjaG`, column 79, in 35% of chromosomes.

**The model names persistent genes readily**, 98% at 0.17 bits, and cloud genes poorly, 18% at 2.96 bits. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.00 against 0.24 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 96%.

label: mdtN
facts:
WINDOW: the mdtN window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor mdtN, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,043 to 4,122 from dnaA. Read in 527 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying mdtN once); 42,160 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.34 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,615 calls, named 98%, 0.17 bits; shell 8,066 calls, named 73%, 0.89 bits; cloud 479 calls, named 18%, 2.96 bits. Outside an RGP 36,573 calls, named 96%, 0.24 bits; inside an RGP 5,587 calls, named 71%, 1.00 bits. Columns: 32 spine, 11 fork, 37 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.00 against 0.24 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 96%); 5,587 of the 42,160 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 28 (yjbS) 1.08 bits, RGP 5%; column 35 (zur) 0.92 bits, RGP 21%; column 27 (aphA) 0.86 bits, RGP 5%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 35-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 12-36%; the least: column 16 (variable), RGP 0.4%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-15 (16 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-12%. Genes: mdtN, mdtO "multidrug efflux transporter permea…", mdtP, fdhF, yjcO "Sel1 family TPR-like repeat protein…", gltP, nrfG, nrfF, nrfE, nrfD, nrfC "cytochrome c nitrite reductase Fe-S…", nrfB, nrfA, acs, yjcH "DUF485 domain-containing protein", actP. named 90-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 4 (yjcO), named 90%; most hesitant at column 1 (mdtO), 0.59 bits.
2. column 16 variable: RGP 0.4%. named 82%; 0.80 bits.
   16: espX5 S 66%
3. columns 17-20 (4 columns) spine: share 97%, all P, RGP 0.4-2%. Genes: yjcE "Na+/H+ antiporter", ghxP, soxR "redox-sensitive transcriptional act…", soxS. named 96-99% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 20 (soxS), named 96%, 0.27 bits.
4. column 21 variable: RGP 4%. named 85%; 0.78 bits.
   21: pdeC S 87%
5. columns 22-27 (6 columns) spine: share 91-97%, all P, RGP 4-5%. Genes: yjcB "YjcB family protein", ssb1, uvrA, yjbR "MmcQ/YjbR family DNA-binding protein", yjbQ "secondary thiamine-phosphate syntha…", aphA. named 85-97% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 27 (aphA), named 85%, 0.86 bits.
6. column 28 variable: RGP 5%. named 85%; 1.08 bits.
   28: yjbS S 46%
7. columns 29-34 (6 columns) spine: share 96-97%, all P, RGP 3-11%. Genes: tyrB, alr, dnaB, qorA, pspG, dusA. named 82-97% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 34 (dusA), named 82%, 0.67 bits.
8. columns 35-79 (45 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 12-36%. named 83-95% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 35, named 83%, 0.92 bits.
   a second branch of 7 families through columns 61-67, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 26-30%, all S; the branch's families: sorC, sorD, sorF, sorB, sorA, "PTS system mannose/fructose/sorbose fam…", sorE
   35 fork: zur P 87%; also "DinI-like family protein" S 11%
   36 variable: yjbJ P 87% "CsbD family protein"
   37 fork: dinF P 87%; also "Ldh family oxidoreductase" S 10%
   columns 38-42 variable, share 87%, all P: lexA 87%, dgkA 87%, plsB 87%, ubiA 87%, ubiC "chorismate lyase" 87%
   43 fork: malM P 86%; also espX4 S 28%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 23%
   columns 44-60 variable, share 57-87%, 15 P, 2 S: lamB 87%, malK 86%, malE 86%, malF "maltose ABC transporter permease Ma…" 86%, malG 86%, xylE 60%, psiE 86%, "hypothetical protein" 57%, "hypothetical protein" 85%, yjbH "YjbH domain-containing protein" 85%, yjbG "capsule biosynthesis GfcC family pr…" 86%, yjbF "YjbF family lipoprotein" 85%, yjbE "exopolysaccharide production protei…" 86%, pgi 86%, lysC 85%, yjbD "DUF3811 domain-containing protein" 85%, rluF 81%
   61 fork: pepE P 74%
   62 fork: yjbB P 73% "Na/Pi symporter"
   63 fork: metH P 73%
   64 fork: iclR P 72%
   65 fork: espL4 S 35%; also "ShET2/EspL2 family type III secretion s…" S 18%
   66 fork: aceK P 71% "bifunctional isocitrate dehydrogena…"
   67 fork: aceA P 72%
   columns 68-78 variable, share 33-71%, 10 P, 1 S: aceB 71%, metA 70%, yjaB "acetyltransferase" 67%, yjaA "YjaA family stress response protein" 33%, purH 67%, purD 61%, zraR 54%, zraS 49%, zraP "zinc resistance sensor/chaperone Zr…" 45%, yjaH "DUF1481 domain-containing protein" 46%, hupA 42%
   79 fork: yjaG P 35% "DUF416 family protein"; also nfi P 19%, hemE P 10%
